data.title: 埃塔 · 雾化实验的成功瞬间
data.description: 实验室中央，实验体的身影正化作薄雾又缓缓凝聚——恶魔附身者也能用出的雾化技能，在埃塔手里完成了。她难得睁大了眼睛，飞快地记下参数。
data.location: laboratory center with a swirling mist formation circle and monitoring crystals
data.action: observing a swirling mist formation with wide awake eyes for once, scribbling parameters on a notepad
data.promptProse: The mist holds, then reforms. Eta's eyes are fully open — the atomization experiment just made history.
data.animaCaption: Sacrifice is necessary for progress, Eta says. Tonight, progress needed no sacrifice at all.
